objective: Link tables with FOREIGN KEY constraints and choose ON DELETE RESTRICT, CASCADE or SET NULL
secondaryObjectives: Insert, update and delete rows safely, including RETURNING and INSERT ... ON CONFLICT

sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch. CASCADE: 'When a row is deleted from the parent table, all related rows in the child tables are deleted as well'; RESTRICT: 'the delete operation is aborted if there are any related rows in the child tables'; SET NULL sets the child's foreign key columns to NULL.
Every organization, person, count and deadline is invented teaching data; tool output is an authored rendering in the tool style.

brief.situation: You maintain the shop database at Larkspur Garden Center (fictional). Forty customers asked to be erased; the job deletes their customer rows at 18:00. On staging, the same delete also removed 1,920 invoices, because invoices.customer_id references customers with ON DELETE CASCADE. Company policy (fictional) keeps invoices for seven years with personal details removed. It is 17:05.
handover: Invoices hold a copy of the billing name; policy says it must be replaced with 'Erased customer'.

scoring.modelReasoning: On staging the invoices vanished with the customer because invoices.customer_id is ON DELETE CASCADE. Policy keeps invoices seven years with personal details removed, so a delete is the wrong operation. Change the key to RESTRICT and make the job anonymize the customer row and the invoice billing names. SET NULL keeps invoices but leaves the name copy and loses the link; moving the job only moves the loss. Running it on production now deletes 1,920 invoices.
